biotools.summary: PlatinumCRISPr is a web-based tool for structure-optimized sgRNA selection, designed to improve the efficiency of Cas9 genome editing. It evaluates base-pairing and sequence composition parameters for optimal sgRNA design and is described in a publication in Genome Research.
